title: SciLifeLab Training Webpage Template
description:
A Quarto-based template for creating, publishing and maintaining FAIR, reusable training websites with GitHub Pages. A landing page lists all instances of a training, and each training instance has its own website with an overview, schedule, content pages, syllabus and information pages, generated from structured data files.

Website: https://scilifelab-training.github.io/scilifelab-training-template/
